comments.text: Before I say this, I have to say art is the most subjective thing in the world and I can totally see why people find this game beautiful. With that said, I can’t stand the art style and it’s one of the biggest things keeping me from enjoying the game. The constant use of bright colors feels like an optic assault because there’s nothing to balance them out. I normally love bright colors but I feel like I’m being flashbanged every time I load into a round. Especially that one room type with the red lights, oh my goodness it genuinely hurts my eyes. However, all the shells do have incredible designs and look awesome. No issues with those.
